$schema.description: The address of this JSON schema, for editors; codeint does not read it.

source_sets.description: Globs of repository-relative paths that put files into a Source set, whatever the Source set rules say. When globs of several Source sets match one file, the first of vendored, generated, test, and production wins.

title: codeint.json
description: The configuration of codeint, read from codeint.json at the root of the repository.

production.description: Globs of files that belong to the Production Source set.

test.description: Globs of files that belong to the Test Source set.

generated.description: Globs of files that belong to the Generated Source set.

vendored.description: Globs of files that belong to the Vendored Source set.
